drivers: S&P 500 futures climbed (Bradenton Herald)
SPY currently trades around $770-$775
Anticipation of Nvidia earnings, Fed sympo
Positive S&P 500 EPS growth outlook
en.why_matters: This movement indicates increasing market confidence in the S&P 500's stability, reducing concerns about a significant near-term downturn. It reflects a more optimistic outlook for September.
en.bull_case: Continued strong corporate earnings and a dovish Fed stance could push SPY higher, making a $700 target unreachable.
en.bear_case: Unexpected negative economic data or a hawkish Fed surprise could trigger a sharp sell-off, driving SPY towards $700.

zh.summary: 标普500（SPY）九月跌至700美元的可能性下降1.9%至4%，主要受标普500期货上涨驱动。据《布雷登顿先驱报》报道，标普500期货在英伟达财报和美联储会议前攀升。

标普500每股收益增长前景积极
